title: Germany bus crash: Most Filipinos discharged; some still hospitalized

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Most Filipinos injured in a bus crash that killed two of their compatriots in Bavaria, Germany, have been discharged from hospitals and cleared to return to Milan, Italy, the Philippine Consulate General in Frankfurt said Tuesday (Philippine time). Several Filipinos remain under medical care for serious injuries, the consulate said in a statement issued Monday night in Germany. The accident occurred Sunday on the A96 highway near Buchloe, west of Munich, when a bus carrying 33 Filipino tourists from Milan veered off the road and overturned while traveling to the Oktoberfest beer festival.
